verses.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.pt: Vi na destra do que estava assentado sobre o trono um livro escrito por dentro e por fora, bem selado com sete selos.
verses.en_web: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat, a book with writing inside it and on the back, shut with seven stamps of wax.

verses.en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.pt: Vi também um anjo forte, clamando com grande voz: Quem é digno de abrir o livro e de romper os seus selos?
verses.en_web: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
verses.en_bbe: And I saw a strong angel saying in a loud voice, Who is able to make the book open, and to undo its stamps?

verses.en: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.pt: E ninguém no céu, nem na terra, nem debaixo da terra, podia abrir o livro, nem olhar para ele.
verses.en_web: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.
verses.en_bbe: And no one in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to get the book open, or to see what was in it.

verses.en: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.pt: E eu chorava muito, porque não fora achado ninguém digno de abrir o livro nem de olhar para ele.
verses.en_web: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.
verses.en_bbe: And I was very sad, because there was no one able to get the book open or to see what was in it.

verses.en: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.pt: E disse-me um dentre os anciãos: Não chores; eis que o Leão da tribo de Judá, a raiz de Davi, venceu para abrir o livro e romper os sete selos.
verses.en_web: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
verses.en_bbe: And one of the rulers said to me, Do not be sad: see, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome, and has power to undo the book and its seven stamps.

verses.en: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.pt: Nisto vi, entre o trono e os quatro seres viventes, no meio dos anciãos, um Cordeiro em pé, como havendo sido morto, e tinha sete chifres e sete olhos, que são os sete espíritos de Deus, enviados por toda a terra.
verses.en_web: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw in the middle of the high seat and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the rulers, a Lamb in his place, which seemed as if it had been put to death, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

verses.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.pt: E veio e tomou o livro da destra do que estava assentado sobre o trono.
verses.en_web: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
verses.en_bbe: And he came and took it out of the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat.

verses.en: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.pt: Logo que tomou o livro, os quatro seres viventes e os vinte e quatro anciãos prostraram-se diante do Cordeiro, tendo cada um deles uma harpa e taças de ouro cheias de incenso, que são as orações dos santos.
verses.en_web: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and the four and twenty rulers went down on their faces before the Lamb, having every one an instrument of music, and gold vessels full of perfumes, which are the prayers of the saints.

verses.en: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.pt: E cantavam um cântico novo, dizendo: Digno és de tomar o livro, e de abrir os seus selos; porque foste morto, e com o teu sangue compraste para Deus homens de toda tribo, e língua, e povo e nação;
verses.en_web: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
verses.en_bbe: And their voices are sounding in a new song, saying, It is right for you to take the book and to make it open: for you were put to death and have made an offering to God of your blood for men of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,

verses.en: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.pt: e para o nosso Deus os fizeste reino, e sacerdotes; e eles reinarão sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they are ruling on the earth.

verses.en: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.pt: E olhei, e vi a voz de muitos anjos ao redor do trono e dos seres viventes e dos anciãos; e o número deles era miríades de miríades; e o número deles era miríades de miríades e milhares de milhares,
verses.en_web: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;
verses.en_bbe: And I saw, and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

verses.en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.pt: que com grande voz diziam: Digno é o Cordeiro, que foi morto, de receber o poder, e riqueza, e sabedoria, e força, e honra, e glória, e louvor.
verses.en_web: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying with a great voice, It is right to give to the Lamb who was put to death, power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.

verses.en: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Ouvi também a toda criatura que está no céu, e na terra, e debaixo da terra, e no mar, e a todas as coisas que neles há, dizerem: Ao que está assentado sobre o trono, e ao Cordeiro, seja o louvor, e a honra, e a glória, e o domínio pelos séculos dos séculos:
verses.en_web: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
verses.en_bbe: And to my ears came the voice of everything in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and of all things which are in them, saying, To him who is seated on the high seat, and to the Lamb, may blessing and honour and glory and power be given for ever and ever.

verses.en: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
verses.pt: e os quatro seres viventes diziam: Amém. E os anciãos prostraram-se e adoraram.
verses.en_web: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.en_bbe: And the four beasts said, So be it. And the rulers went down on their faces and gave worship.
